versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.0

- Removed the file: skill-card.md
- No changes to core functionality or logic; this update only removes an auxiliary documentation file.

Version 1.0.1 (bid-compliance-due-diligence-v2)

- Major upgrade: Skill repositioned from “招标文件查重/围串标检测” to “招投标合规风险尽调”，聚焦企业合规、负面信息和法定风险穿透审查。
- New structure: 全面重写 SKILL.md，集成双知识库（政府采购与招投标实务），引入因果链、规则细则与流程分明的执行指引，详细规范参数和输出。
- Toolchain update: 移除脚本/文档解析与查重流程，新增 WebSearch/WebFetch 与 IMAMCP 知识库API集成，支持实时官方负面信息检索。
- Output redesign: 输出切换为企业合规风险报告，支持 quick（快速筛查）与 deep（深度审计）两级模式，结构化分级定性、事实与推演分离。
- File housekeeping: 添加对照/测试

## Changelog for bid-compliance-due-diligence-v2 v1.0.0

- Released new version as "标书查重专家" (bid-dup-check) with comprehensive bid document duplicate-check and collusion risk screening capabilities.
- Supports structure and semantic comparison of 2–10 uploaded Chinese bidding/tender documents in .docx, .pdf (text layer), or .txt formats.
- Detects similarities in core info (company, personnel, contact etc.), document properties, textual and table content, and structural differences.
- Provides structured, risk-graded reports with clear explanations, baseline (tender doc) exclusion, and explicit schema; allows exporting to Word.
- Includes robust error handling, OCR support (if available), limitations marking, and strong emphasis on appropriate use (for rapid self-checks and preliminary screening, not formal committee judgments).
